Nisar Dishant Amrutlal’s Biography

Nisar Dishant Amrutlal's journey is rooted in his home state of Gujarat, specifically Bhachau in Kutch. He comes from a Jain family; his father is self-employed. Before entering the civil services, he pursued a Bachelor's degree in Mass Media. He also worked as an editor for a short film. This background highlights his diverse skills and ability to adapt to new challenges. His transition to civil services shows his strong determination.
Academic Background and Optional Subject Choice

Nisar Dishant Amrutlal’s education in Mass Media and Journalism developed his critical thinking and communication skills. These abilities are crucial for UPSC preparation. His professional experience in media sharpened his analytical faculties. This helped him understand complex topics in General Studies papers. He chose Political Science & International Relations (PSIR) as his optional subject for the UPSC exam. PSIR is a popular choice due to its relevance to governance and global issues. This choice aligned well with his analytical strengths.
